{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) condemns the concerted and sustained attack on Brazilian democracy by the government of Michel Temer and his allies in the Brazilian judiciary.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA calls upon the government of Brazil to restore all political, civil and social rights that have been eroded during Temer’s presidency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA asserts that the political rights of former President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva have been eroded during Temer’s presidency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA asserts that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was jailed earlier this year on unsubstantiated and politically-motivated corruption charges.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"During Temer’s presidency, basic individual political and civil rights of Brazilians have been curtailed through violations of due process.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"During Temer’s presidency, politically-motivated judicial persecutions have occurred.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"During Temer’s presidency, shameless police brutality against anti-government protestors has occurred.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"During Temer’s presidency, there has been a spike in extra-judicial police killings.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Marielle Franco, a Rio city council member and prominent human rights activist, was killed in March of 2018.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Temer’s government enacted legislation attacking the social rights of ordinary Brazilians.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Temer’s government passed a constitutional amendment capping public spending.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Temer’s government passed a set of labor reforms that dramatically weaken the rights of Brazilian workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The government is working diligently to pass legislation slashing workers’ pensions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
